notes: **2026-09-02** — (branch `fix/F14-authz-matrix-v2`, off master `39632d27`; no schema change) — **F14 AUTHORIZATION / TENANCY MATRIX (B52 Critical/B132/B133/B138/B155/B165/B168).** Seven gaps across one seam — a permission check declared somewhere other than where the request actually flows. B52: uploads.controller.ts gained an eighth owner lookup (supplier-statements/) plus a general fail-closed default-deny for any key under an unmapped prefix; all three JWT-path denials now warn-log the branch, key and caller before the (unchanged, opaque) 403, since nothing else records a 403. B132/B133/B168: three unrelated DRIVER grants dropped (customers price-override POST, order-templates create/update/addItem/removeItem + a new ownership-aware addItemForUser, inventory's 4 handler-level @Roles overrides that shadowed the class gate) — same root cause, a decorator that outlived the driver screen it was written for. B165: impersonatedBy now propagates through both JWT strategies into req.user, is stamped onto every AuditLog row, and ImpersonationGuard — which had been reading request.user for a claim that Nest's APP_GUARD ordering means is NEVER populated there — now decodes the bearer payload by hand. B138: AuthController.logout no longer revokes the impersonated TENANT_ADMIN's real sessions on every device when a super-admin exits; web's lib/impersonation.ts exitImpersonation() is the single exit, and the header avatar menu no longer offers Sign out while impersonating. B155: auth.service.ts refresh() rotates the RefreshToken row in place (CAS updateMany) instead of delete-then-reissue, so Active Sessions shows the true sign-in time across rotations; SessionsCard gained data-session-id + an honest (Promise.allSettled) revoke-all. T2 (web) discharge is post-deploy (D1) — e2e specs 31/32 + project entries ship in this PR; e2e-seed.js seeds an ACTIVE TENANT_ADMIN (e2e_admin) spec 31 needs.
